_note: Evergreen editorial seed pool for audacity, written by Claude on 2026-11-05 for owner review. Tips, ideas, real tools (homepage links only) and generic opportunities. No news: news only comes from the brand's listed feeds. Edit freely.

items.title: Do one thing this week that scares you a little
items.summary: Small risks build the habit.

items.title: Write the life you would choose if no one watched
items.summary: Then pick the smallest step toward it.

items.title: Ask one more question than feels polite
items.summary: The best story is usually in the second answer.

items.title: Write down a story the day you hear it
items.summary: Details fade quickly.

items.title: Thank a person specifically, not generally
items.summary: Say exactly what they did and why it mattered.

items.title: Record a family member's story
items.summary: Ten questions and a phone are enough to keep a life on record.

items.title: Start a neighbor spotlight
items.summary: One short profile a month of someone doing good work nearby.

items.title: Collect ten small acts of kindness in a month
items.summary: Notice them and write them down.

items.title: StoryCorps
items.summary: Record and preserve conversations with the people who matter to you.

items.title: Humans of New York
items.summary: Portraits and short stories of everyday people.

items.title: Audacity
items.summary: A free, open-source audio recorder and editor.

items.title: Volunteer for a cause you keep talking about
items.summary: Move from commenting to doing, even for a few hours.

items.title: Run a story night at a local café
items.summary: Five tellers, five minutes each.

items.title: Teach what you learned to someone within a day
items.summary: Explaining is the fastest test of understanding.

items.title: Space your review: a day, a week, a month
items.summary: Spaced repetition beats cramming.

items.title: Run a 30-day challenge on one skill
items.summary: Small daily practice builds more than occasional bursts.

items.title: Start a weekly study group
items.summary: The commitment keeps everyone going.

items.title: Khan Academy
items.summary: Free lessons and practice in maths, science and more.

items.title: Anki
items.summary: Free flashcards that use spaced repetition.

items.title: Audit a free university course
items.summary: Many universities share lectures and notes at no cost.
